terms: Zrzur is a volunteer project, and this is a volunteer role in it: unpaid, with no fixed hours and no duty to be available. You can step down at any time. It is not a job and not employment.
received.title: Your application arrived
interview.title: A short talk about your application
interview.body:
{reviewer} from the Zrzur Team will write to you in a private message about your application for “{role}”.

The team never asks for your password, a sign-in code, money or documents.

owner_manual.title: Accepted: a role only you can give
owner_manual.body: {reviewer} accepted {applicant} for “{role}”. Zrzur never gives this role by itself. If you agree, give it by hand.
role.support.name: Support
role.support.description: Answers people's questions and points them to the right place.
role.support.rules: Be kind and patient, answer only what you know, and pass on what you cannot solve. Never ask anyone for a password or a code. What you read in staff channels stays there.
role.moderator.name: Moderator
role.moderator.description: Keeps the server friendly and within the Community Guidelines.
role.moderator.rules: Act on the Community Guidelines, not on taste. Warn before you remove, write a reason for every action, and never moderate a dispute you are part of. What you read in staff channels and reports stays there.
role.discover-reviewer.name: Discover Reviewer
role.discover-reviewer.description: Reviews servers and bots that ask to be listed on Discover.
role.discover-reviewer.rules: Judge every request by the listing rules only, never review your own or a friend's server or bot, and write a clear reason when you reject. What you read in staff channels stays there.
role.community-manager.name: Community Manager
role.community-manager.description: Plans events and keeps the server active and welcoming.
role.community-manager.rules: Announce events early, keep them open to everyone, and never promise prizes or perks in Zrzur's name without the owner's word. What you read in staff channels stays there.
role.designer.name: Designer
role.designer.description: Makes artwork and designs for Zrzur and its community.
role.designer.rules: Share only designs that are your own or that you may use, and name the source of anything you did not make. Nothing is copied from other apps.
role.developer.name: Developer
role.developer.description: Helps build Zrzur, its bots and its developer documentation.
role.developer.rules: Contributions go through pull requests under the project's licence. Never share keys, tokens or other people's data, and report a security problem in private first.
role.administrator.name: Administrator
role.administrator.description: Helps run the official servers together with the owner.
role.administrator.rules: This role is given by the owner in person and can be taken back at any time. Use every power only for the task it was given for, and write down what you change. What you read in staff channels stays there.
question.experience.label: Your experience
question.experience.hint: What have you done that fits this role? Links are welcome.
question.why.label: Why do you want this role?
question.why.hint: A few honest lines are enough.
accepted_notice.title: You accepted an application
accepted_notice.body: You accepted {applicant} for “{role}”. If this is not what you meant to do, tell the owner of Zrzur at once.
